test_get_crime_rate_happy_path: test the get-crime-rate CLI command returns violent and property crime rates for a valid zip code
test_get_crime_rate_unknown_zip: test the get-crime-rate CLI command returns exit code 1 when the zip code does not exist
test_get_crime_rate_increments_api_call_: test the get-crime-rate command increments the api_call_count in persisted state after each call
test_get_crime_rate_rate_limited: test the get-crime-rate command returns an error when api_call_count reaches the configured limit of 100
test_rate_limit_cooldown_expired: test the get-crime-rate command succeeds again after the 30-minute rate limit cooldown period has expired
